title: AM Best Upgrades Financial Strength Rating to “A” (Excellent) for Hamilton Select
summary: Hamilton Insurance Group, Ltd. (NYSE: HG) (“Hamilton” or the “Company”) announced today that AM Best has upgraded the Financial Strength Rating to “A” (Excellent) for Hamilton Select Insurance, Inc. (“Hamilton Select”), the Company’s US excess and surplus lines (“ES”) underwriting platform. The outlook of this Credit Rating is stable. AM Best noted that the ratings upgrade of Hamilton Select is primarily driven by recent enhancements of the explicit support provided by Hamilton and also reflects Hamilton Select’s strategic importance to Hamilton.
